experiment: Each of ten axis weights individually multiplied by 0.75 or 1.25, renormalized by sum(weights), for all 2^10 extreme vectors. Scores frozen and subjective.
conclusion: The 0.5928 total is not robust to all plausible weight perturbations. Weight sweep tests arithmetic sensitivity only and cannot calibrate the score itself.
supersedes: Earlier R106 narrative offered illustrative scholarship-first 0.685 and novelty-first 0.489 without complete published weight vectors; these must not be treated as independently reproducible sensitivity endpoints. Use R111 explicitly defined 1024-case perturbations for the verifiable comparison.
